t: These are the Obelisks of Nectanebo II, a pair of monumental obelisks in the Great Court of the British Museum. They're fragmentary, and they were first put up in the ancient city of Hermopolis, in central Egypt, by Nectanebo II, the last native ruler of ancient Egypt. French scholars recovered them during Napoleon's 1798 expedition. After French forces capitulated, the British confiscated them, along with the Rosetta Stone, and brought them to England.
